text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Constrain list-version identity**

When a list supplies a blank string, number, array, or object as its version, AC19 does not say whether that value is malformed: it defines domains for every category field but only checks that a version is present. Because this value is displayed in summaries and determines whether the ten-PR evidence count resets, implementations can disagree about version equality or accept a version that cannot be meaningfully reported. Define a stable version domain, such as a non-blank scalar string with exact comparison semantics.
